prompt: A draft summary credits the revised recipe with a hands-on time saving in the controlled comparison. What correction should Clara make?
promptZh: 摘要草稿稱，在受控比較中，新版工法節省了實際作業時間。Clara 應如何修正？

options.text: Keep the stated saving because both covers ultimately passed inspection.
options.zh: 保留省時結論，因為兩片外蓋最終都通過檢驗。
options.whyZh: 檢驗合格不代表投入的作業時間較少。

options.text: Keep the stated saving because work at a second bench is a separate operation.
options.zh: 保留省時結論，因為第二個工作台的作業應分開計算。
options.whyZh: 凡是重新拉絲的作業時間都須計入。

options.text: Report a time increase because the wait for the touch-up bench must be included.
options.zh: 改為耗時增加，因為等候補修台的時間必須計入。
options.whyZh: 等待屬於閒置時間，不計入。

options.text: Report a time increase because extra brushing outweighed the initial saving.
options.zh: 改為耗時增加，因為重新拉絲的時間超過首次拉絲節省的時間。
options.whyZh: 新版首次拉絲 64 秒，補修再用 22 秒，共 86 秒；舊版共 79 秒。

explanationZh: 新版首次拉絲 64 秒，補修再用 22 秒，共 86 秒；舊版共 79 秒。

vocabulary.note: first brush 是第一道拉絲；實作時間也計入補修時的重拉絲。

evidence: Count time spent brushing, including any extra brushing at the touch-up bench, but exclude idle time. / K61 | A | By hand | Old | Revised | 64 sec | Pass after touch-up / K62 | A | By hand | Revised | Old | 79 sec | Pass / K61 waited ten minutes to get to my bench, then I rebrushed it for 22 seconds.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Count time spent brushing, including any extra brushing at the touch-up bench, but exclude idle time.
K61 | A | By hand | Old | Revised | 64 sec | Pass after touch-up
K62 | A | By hand | Revised | Old | 79 sec | Pass
K61 waited ten minutes to get to my bench, then I rebrushed it for 22 seconds.
